cWFd0[4s$;7!KuV)}NF4.text:
Hey there! If you want to add your own music, first separate your song into it's intro (if it has an intro) and it's looping part in separate sounds, tag "-Start" at the end of the intro's name, then tag "-Loop" at the end of the looping part's name. Add the song's name into either "Add music" block, depending on if it's for the main gameplay or end-game results, & finally drop it here! Remember that EVERYTHING must be correct spelling or else it won't work! Running a test recommended!

If adding a winner jingle, add a "-Start" tag with no spaces and separate its intro (if you prefer). then, add an "-End" tag to make the jingle have its ending part or you can do it WITHOUT the "-Start" tag (recommended).

If the music track/winner jingle comes from a party game, like Mario Party, Wii Party or WarioWare: MEGA Party Game$, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like SmashBrosFan2020. If the music track gets faster overtime, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like Twin138956Scratch. I, Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, also recommend you please don't add any more than around 60 music tracks total, to prevent lag or the dreaded "refusal-to-save glitch" when modifiying the project on less powerful devices. It's also best to refrain from adding too many music tracks longer than 3 minutes (180 seconds) or too many "gets faster" tracks.
